description: Versioned enforcement floor for taxis commit-message governance. This file is tracked in the repository, so raising the floor is a reviewable change. The command-line --policy selector may adopt a stricter preset than `floor` but must never adopt a looser one; a downgrade attempt is rejected with FGT-MSG-011 instead of being silently applied.

deniedTiers.reason: git-native disables every workspace obligation, including project scope, declaration anchors and vocabulary checks. It exists only for reading foreign repositories and must never author a commit in a governed repository.

headerMetrics.rationale: Character counting keeps a 30-character Chinese subject legal; byte counting rejected it at 90 bytes. The reference implementation in scripts/common/commit-structure-contract.js also counts characters.

bypass.rationale: A real exception must be an explicit act that leaves a record. Letting --policy switch the gate off made the guard advisory while looking binding.
